title: Claude can now turn artifacts into Mac and Windows apps
dek: Claude's desktop apps, prototyping beside production, futures thinking, five weekend videos, a touch-ready Things, three events.
preheader: Claude turns artifacts into desktop apps, a case for prototyping on production code, and five videos for the weekend.
hero_alt: A pixel book and steaming mug by a rainy window
summary: Claude can now [turn an artifact into a Mac or Windows app](https://claude.com/resources/articles/install-as-app) that uses your connectors. Matt Ström-Awn makes the case for [prototyping on a branch of production](https://mattstromawn.com/writing/mirror-mode/). And Android Auto [moves app tabs into a sidebar on wide screens](https://9to5google.com/2026/11/25/android-auto-wide-display-update/).
